mapper.sql: id, title, author, digest, cover_url, content_md, content_html, status, website_visible, website_published_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.title, c.author, c.digest, c.cover_url, c.status, c.website_visible, c.website_published_at, c.create_time, c.update_time, lp.app_id AS lp_app_id, lp.status AS lp_status, lp.article_url AS lp_article_url, lp.published_at AS lp_published_at, lp.media_id AS lp_media_id FROM crm_marketing_content c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT p.app_id, p.status, p.article_url, p.published_at, p.media_id FROM crm_marketing_content_publish p WHERE p.content_id = c.id ORDER BY p.update_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) lp ON TRUE
AND ( c.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.author ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.digest ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND c.status = #{status}
AND c.website_visible = #{websiteVisible}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_marketing_content_publish p2 WHERE p2.content_id = c.id AND p2.status = 'published' )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_marketing_content_publish p2 WHERE p2.content_id = c.id AND p2.status = 'published' )
ORDER BY c.update_time DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT id, title, author, digest, cover_url, website_published_at, update_time FROM crm_marketing_content WHERE website_visible = true ORDER BY website_published_at DESC NULLS LAST, update_time DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM crm_marketing_content WHERE id = #{id}::uuid AND website_visible = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_marketing_content ( id, title, author, digest, cover_url, content_md, content_html, status, website_visible, website_published_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{title}, #{author}, #{digest}, #{coverUrl}, COALESCE(#{contentMd}, ''), #{contentHtml}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'draft'), COALESCE(#{websiteVisible}, false), #{websitePublishedAt}, #{createBy}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, now()), #{updateBy}, COALESCE(#{updateTime}, now()) )
mapper.update:
UPDATE crm_marketing_content
title = #{title}, author = #{author}, digest = #{digest}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, content_md = #{contentMd}, content_html = #{contentHtml}, status = #{status},
website_visible = #{websiteVisible}, website_published_at = #{websitePublishedAt},
update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = COALESCE(#{updateTime}, now())
WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
